evidence.quote: The language of instruction is English for the first year. Classes take place in German from the third semester onwards.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
Apply online via our application portal: https://campus.th-mannheim.de
English language skills needed Proof of sufficient English language skills is one of the admission prerequisites (TOEFL minimum 88 (IBT) or 4.5; IELTS minimum 6.5; OTE minimum 130).

notes: DAAD page gives tuition 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants; local page confirms (1,500 EUR per semester) but is institutional; DAAD page is programme-specific. Application deadlines for EEB not included because no quote explicitly states they are for non-EU/international applicants with foreign qualification. Page recommends application by 15 May for international students (soft wording, not a strict deadline).
